# relgap registry test

Digests the range once per source of the tool's entry and once with all of them, and
prints for each: the versions it found notes for, its entry counts and the documents they came
from. Entries below --min-confidence count too.

&lt;tool&gt; resolves as in 'relgap resolve'. A path to a .yaml file runs that entry on its own, after
the checks 'relgap registry lint' makes, so a new entry can be tried before it's embedded.

A source that fails is listed with its error and the command exits 1. A source without notes in
the range isn't an error: an upgrade guide only has notes where a new release line starts.

## Usage

```sh
relgap registry test <tool|file.yaml> <from>..[<to>] [flags]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `tool\|file.yaml` | yes | no |
| `from>..[<to` | yes | no |

## Flags

| Flag | Description | Type | Default | Values | Config key | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--guess` | search GitHub for a tool no registry knows and use the exact name match with the most stars | bool |  |  |  |  |

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Output formats

`--format` accepts `tty`, `plain`, `json`. Without it, the format is `tty` when stdout is a terminal and `plain` otherwise. Formats are described on the [global flags](/cli/global-flags) page.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The command finished. With --fail-on, nothing matched. |
| 1 | The command failed: a read, a write, a child process or a check failed. |
| 2 | Wrong usage: an unknown command or flag, a bad value or argument, an invalid config file, or a prompt with no terminal. |
| 4 | Credentials were missing or rejected for every source the command needed. |
| 130 | Interrupted by Ctrl-C (SIGINT) or a cancelled context. |

All codes are listed on the [exit codes](/reference/exit-codes) page.

## Examples

```sh
relgap registry test kubectl 1.36.0..1.37.2
relgap registry test registry/argocd.yaml 3.5.0..3.6.1
relgap registry test python 3.13.5..3.14.0 --format json
```
